ios.desc:
Run in the real world. Become a hero in another.

Zombies, Run! is the world’s most popular smartphone fitness game — over 10 million runners, a 4.8-star rating, and 500+ missions across 11 seasons and counting, co-created by award-winning novelist Naomi Alderman.

Every run becomes a mission. You’re Runner 5, and through your headphones the story unfolds: rescue survivors, gather supplies, outrun the horde, and uncover the truth about the zombie apocalypse. It’s so much fun you’ll forget you’re working out.

• Made for every body and every pace. Total beginner or marathon veteran, it works anywhere and at any speed — jog in a park, walk a trail, use a treadmill, or work out in a wheelchair.

• Includes a Couch to 5K training program like no other. Learn to run with thrilling, immersive storytelling. 

• Your music, your soundtrack. The story weaves between tracks from your own playlists.

• A fully-featured fitness app. GPS tracking, detailed stats, and unlockable story extras as you progress. Rebuild Abel Township from a few shivering survivors into a fortified beacon of civilisation.

Try Zombies, Run! for free, or subscribe to unlock every mission.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://support.zombiesrungame.com/hc/en-us/articles/10967895586461-Zombies-Run-Subscription-Terms

Privacy: https://support.zombiesrungame.com/hc/en-us/articles/360005935458-Privacy-Policy

Note: Continued GPS use in the background can decrease battery life.

quotes.text:
Have you tried something like Zombies, Run?

It is kind of a gamified running game, with audio clips and interactive elements. For example, at certain times zombies appear and you have to increase your pace for a bit. In the meantime you follow a story about a post-apocalyptic world, with characters etc. I tried it for a while, worked pretty well!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zombies-run/id503519713
